messages:
incident-bot: ALERT · serving-runtime-pool-7 memory pressure > 90% · 5 OOM events in 5m · affected pods: runtime-7a, runtime-7b, runtime-7c :bangbang:

mike-oncall: I'm oncall. Paging eng-oncall. visible 503 spikes from the API gateway and a few container restarts. ETA 1m to pull logs.

sara-engineer: looking at runtime-7a logs now. repeated pattern: `CUDAError: out of memory` then the paged-attention allocator shows large fragmentation. also seeing KV cache evictions failing and growth on heap side.

sara-engineer: logs snippet:
```
[2026-03-15T14:02:11Z] runtime serving-runtime-7a pid=1024 ERROR CUDAError: out of memory
[2026-03-15T14:02:11Z] runtime allocator: paged-attn slab used=1.72GB free=48MB frag=92%
[2026-03-15T14:02:12Z] runtime cache: kv-evict failed: cannot acquire lock
[2026-03-15T14:02:13Z] runtime watchdog: process exited status=137
```

anish-infra: confirmed on host vm-az3-gpu12: `dmesg` shows multiple OOM killer events, CUDA driver returning `out of memory` before container-level oom. sounds like slow creep fragmentation (paged allocator) rather than single large allocation.

lucy-ops: customer impact — we have 503s for a handful of production keys. Ryan, can you query support for affected accounts? initial sampling shows higher error rate for accounts: [AcmeCorp, NovaApps] in us-west-2.

ryan-support: AcmeCorp reported latency + errors at 14:04. Opening incident message to the account team and CS. Marking as P1 customer impact.

anish-infra: mitigation plan (short):
- disable paged-attention allocator on the affected deployment to stop fragmentation growth (set `REDWOOD_PAGED_ATTENTION=false` and restart pods)
- trigger KV cache eviction via admin API (`POST /admin/kv/evict?scope=all`) to free prefix caches
- roll nodes out of the GPU pool (cordon + drain) if errors persist
- prepare hotfix: cap per-model KV size + lower page threshold (PR ready -> #4521)

mike-oncall: can we do a phased approach? disable allocator on a canary (runtime-7c) first then monitor. if stable, roll rest. we want minimal customer impact.

deploy-bot: Deployment triggered by anish-infra: `set env REDWOOD_PAGED_ATTENTION=false` on deployment serving-runtime-7c at 14:08 UTC. Canary rollout started.

lucy-ops: monitoring: memory pressure drop on 7c immediate? linking grafana snapshot: https://grafana.redwood.internal/d/abcd/serving-runtime?panel=mem&from=now-10m&to=now

sara-engineer: 7c looks healthier after env flip: fragmentation down to 36% and CUDA OOMs stopped. 7a/7b still see repeated OOMs.

mike-oncall: good. proceed to sequential restart of remaining pods with short delay. ensure we evict KV caches pre-restart.

anish-infra: running admin eviction across pool now. `curl -s -X POST https://admin.internal/kv/evict?scope=pool-7 -H 'Authorization: Bearer $$$'`  — success 200. kicking rolling restart: `kubectl rollout restart deploy/serving-runtime -n inference --selector=pool=7` with 30s stagger.

incident-bot: NOTE · 7/9 pods restarted, 2 still pending termination. error rate trending down from 12% -> 1.8% in last 10m.

ryan-support: CS updated AcmeCorp with temporary routing to fallback model variant for critical traffic. they're ok with degraded quality rather than errors.

lucy-ops: post-eviction and restart check: no new CUDA OOMs in last 7m across pool-7, kernel OOM events reduced. but sustained leak signal in allocator metrics pre-patch.

mike-oncall: assigning actions:
- anish-infra: finalize and merge PR #4521 (cap KV per-model + lower page threshold) and schedule a canary deploy tomorrow 02:00 UTC.
- sara-engineer: collect heap + allocator flamegraph for the affected timeline and save to S3 `s3://redwood-incidents/1779994999/` (attach everything to the incident).
- lucy-ops: coordinate customer communications and keep fallback routing until patch validated.

ops-handoff-bot: Handoff queued to next oncall (oncall@redwood) at 14:22 UTC. Summary: paged-attention allocator fragmentation + KV eviction contention led to slow creep to OOM and container crashes; temporary mitigation applied (disabled paged allocator + KV eviction + rolling restart); customer fallback routing enabled; PR #4521 targets root cause. Postmortem owner: sara-engineer.

mike-oncall: adding runbook links: https://wiki.redwood/internal/runbooks/paged-attention-oom and https://wiki.redwood/internal/playbooks/kv-evict

sara-engineer: attaching more logs and perf traces to the incident now. prepping postmortem draft.

mike-oncall: thanks all. leaving this thread to next oncall. react with :white_check_mark: when you have read the handoff.

incident-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE · status=mitigated · nodes healthy=6/6 · customers remaining on fallback=2 · follow-up required: postmortem, hotfix canary, longer-term allocator redesign.
